method: Renewed on 2026-11-13: the post and research file are byte-identical to the previously approved versions (content and research hashes match), the KCA comparison page and the EPA humidifier fact sheet were re-fetched and return HTTP 200, and the key figures were re-read from the source notes - 13 products tested, humidification output 182 to 606 ml/h (3.3 times spread), annual maintenance cost 4,640 to 6,420 won for ultrasonic versus 72,750 to 91,070 won for steam, steam at 99 degrees, noise 37 to 62 dB - so the approval is renewed without changing any claim.
